title: Compact agent patterns workshop and runbook: lightweight tool-calling examples and structured-output lab
author: Riley Chen
release_notes: Adds a compact workshop and runbook for agent patterns: lightweight tool-calling templates, structured-output validation examples, and telemetry presets for quick RAG experimentation.
description: Context: teams frequently request small, composable agent examples they can embed in feature branches and workshops without the overhead of full RAG stacks. Motivation: provide a compact set of agent patterns (synchronous tool-calls, deferred tool batching, structured-output contracts) plus a short runbook that explains when to choose each pattern and a minimal telemetry preset for fast diagnostics. What this PR does: 1) adds a compact workshop under examples/agent-patterns that contains three runnable agent templates (sync-toolflow, batch-tool-conductor, contract-first-parser) with README-driven exercises; 2) provides a runbook (docs/quickstarts/agent-patterns-runbook.md) that maps real product scenarios to patterns, includes cost/latency tradeoffs and quick checklist for production hardening; 3) introduces a tiny telemetry preset and example probes (telemetry/presets/compact-agent.json and telemetry/probes/sample-probes.js) so engineers get actionable traces and token-cost breakdowns during the workshop; 4) updates the devcontainer and CI smoke job to support the lightweight workshop. Checklist: - [x] Add runnable templates with minimal dependencies and step-by-step README - [x] Add runbook with decision matrix and rollback guidance - [x] Add telemetry presets and example probes - [x] Add tests and smoke CI job for the workshop - [x] Get approvals from docs and examples reviewers Not included in this PR: full-scale eval harness, language translations and multi-region deployment guides (follow-ups tracked in ENG-9142). Links: Linear: ENG-9142. Support ticket: SUP-987.
